title: Implement confirmed three-round character mood consultation v3
prompt: Implement the CONFIRMED Character Mood Consultation v3 on the current Ready isolated branch, after inspecting the current HEAD and preserving all newer whole-foundation/continuity work. This supersedes the current six-at-once choose-three screen. Contract: PHOTO is the sole/top identity authority. Mood is creative expression/generation direction, never personality diagnosis. UX is exactly THREE choices per round, choose ONE, for THREE rounds: Round 1 -> 1/3, Round 2 -> 2/3, Round 3 -> 3/3. The underlying extensible pool may retain the six confirmed directions: 신나!, 두근두근, 포근해, 멋져!, 집중!, 상상중. Round 2 and Round 3 must filter/recommend options to maximize meaningful visual/emotional distance from prior selections; do not present near-duplicates. After each chosen direction, at most 0-2 optional refining keywords may be offered; brief and skippable, not a permanent form section. After three selections, transition to generation-preparation/locked state. Sequential candidate contract remains: same original PHOTO identity -> direction A -> candidate1; same PHOTO -> B -> candidate2; same PHOTO -> C -> candidate3; compare -> choose -> resemblance refinement against ORIGINAL PHOTO -> final master. Paid/provider generation remains HARD LOCKED and must not be called. Visual implementation requirements from actual browser evidence: mobile cards should be compact, expressive, child-friendly and clearly distinct rather than text-form slabs; selected state strong; original photo-to-consultation relationship obvious; PC must use controlled app/max-width composition and must not stretch cards across full viewport. Preserve >=44px targets and iPhone safe area. Do not use emoji as final art; if final art assets are unavailable, use CSS/typographic placeholder treatment and mark visual-art asset gap instead of pretending PASS. Add deterministic tests for 3 rounds, no duplicate/near-same direction selection, progress, optional keyword skip, stable PHOTO identity contract, paid-generation lock, and desktop max-width/static visual markers. Do not touch main/prod/deploy/release/location/Snap growth/rewards. Do not implement WEEK/DAY maps in this task. Final report must separate FUNCTIONAL PASS, STATIC RESPONSIVE PASS, actual rendered VISUAL DEVICE UNVERIFIED and paid generation locked.
